# Cohort Comms

> Internal communications platform for the Hult Cohort Developer Program
> (Summer Pilot 2026, Project 2). Replaces Discord: channels, direct messages,
> global search, emoji reactions, admin-only announcements, unread badges,
> presence, and light/dark themes — with the Forth project board embedded in
> the app and a live inbound webhook from Forth.

- Production: https://cohort-comms-phi.vercel.app
- Demo (no signup): https://cohort-comms-phi.vercel.app/demo
- Source: https://github.com/priyanshshahh/cohort-comms
- Author: @priyanshshahh

## Stack

Next.js 16 (App Router), Clerk authentication, Neon Postgres via Drizzle ORM,
deployed on Vercel. Message delivery is short-interval SWR polling (2s in a
conversation, 5s for the sidebar) rather than WebSockets.

## Project management integration (Forth)

Forth (https://forth-bice.vercel.app) publishes no public REST API and no
outbound webhooks, so integration works at four levels:

- Inbound webhook: `POST /api/webhooks/forth`, authenticated by a shared secret
  compared in constant time. Board events post into a channel as a `Forth` bot.
  Only same-origin Forth URLs are rendered; other links are stripped.
- Embedded board: a split-pane renders the live Forth board inside the app.
- Deep-link cards: pasted Forth URLs render as labelled cards.
- Shared identity: both tools authenticate with Google and GitHub OAuth.

## Routes

- `/` — landing page (public)
- `/demo` — read-only product walkthrough, no account required (public)
- `/sign-in`, `/sign-up` — Clerk authentication (public)
- `/c/[slug]` — channel conversation (requires sign-in)
- `/dm/[userId]` — direct message (requires sign-in)
- `/api/webhooks/forth` — inbound board events (shared-secret auth)
